notes: Nordyne-family system, encoded independently from this page's own text only (no usesStylesOf: the page's sister list alone does not establish shared-system reuse, and no Nordyne/Frigidaire rule is imported). COUNTING CONVENTION (Nordyne lesson, tested against this page's own example): page positions are stated as 'numerical digits', but digit-only counting is FALSIFIED by the page's own example JSA060103994: its digits are 060103994, so 6th & 7th numerical digits = '39', an invalid month. Character counting decodes it (year '06' = 2006, month '01' = January), so character counting is this page's convention and is shipped. The page carries a single style; no shape collision arises.

styles.notes: Page positions 4-5 = year, 6-7 = month (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open [3,5] and [5,7]. Character counting (see file notes): '06' year, '01' month.
